title: UA Vehicle Registry — Normalized Record
description: Schema for a single record in the normalized UA vehicle registry Parquet snapshots (v1.0).

person_type.description: Type of owner. P = natural person (фізична особа), J = legal entity (юридична особа).

reg_addr_koatuu.description: KOATUU code of the owner's registered address. Stored as string to preserve leading zeros.

oper_code.description: Numeric code of the registration operation.

oper_name.description: Human-readable name of the registration operation.

d_reg.description: Date of the registration operation (ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DD).

dep_code.description: Numeric code of the service center (department).

vin.description: Vehicle Identification Number. Null for records predating July 2021 (VIN column absent in source).

fuel.description: Fuel type (e.g., БЕНЗИН, ДИЗЕЛЬНЕ ПАЛИВО, ЕЛЕКТРО).

record_ids.description: Array of source record IDs aggregated into this row.

secondary_fuel.description: Secondary fuel type (e.g., ГАЗ for LPG/CNG vehicles).

n_reg_latin.description: Vehicle registration plate transliterated to Latin characters.

is_valid_plate.description: Whether the registration plate passes format validation.

raw_vin.description: Original VIN as received from source. Null for records before 2021.

is_valid_vin.description: Whether the VIN passes checksum and format validation. Null for records before 2021.
